concept: Review and integration: what it feels like to be a wonderer and explorer so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of wondering, chasing questions, and trying new things — which do you enjoy most?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'being curious' means to them so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
